description: EURAC photovoltaic data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Eurac Research. This repository contains technical and operational data related to photovoltaic (PV) energy systems. The dataset includes measurements of fundamental electrical parameters, such as voltage, current, and output power, as well as associated environmental variables (e.g., solar irradiance and module/ambient temperature). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
